facts.fact: 塔姆辛先开口，提议两人该去找点吃的
facts.anchor: We should get something to eat.

facts.fact: 塔姆辛要莉薇带她去看那间挂画的房间
facts.anchor: That room with the paintings—will you take me there?

facts.fact: 莉薇见没人来收拾房间，猜仆人们真把塔姆辛当成了她的女仆
facts.anchor: Maybe they really did believe that Tamsin was my maid.

facts.fact: 莉薇不愿带塔姆辛去自己见过 Rex 的房间，迷信地怕她一进门就看穿自己当时的心动
facts.anchor: I had a superstitious fear that she would immediately know how I’d felt in that high-ceilinged, shadowy space

facts.fact: 莉薇逛烦了便谎称这间屋子就是挂画的房间，补的那句 I think so 只是给谎言留退路
facts.anchor: to absolve myself of the lie

facts.fact: 塔姆辛从架上抽出一本两百年前的女性手术书，翻开给莉薇看解剖素描
facts.anchor: a book on ladies’ surgery, only it’s two hundred years old

facts.fact: 莉薇抽书时掉出来的不是书页，而是四张背面空白的裸女照片明信片
facts.anchor: They weren’t pages from the book but postcards, four in all.

facts.fact: 撞见他们的金发男子自称两人在露台见过面，还叫出了莉薇的名字
facts.anchor: Out on the terrace? Livvie, isn’t it?
